enchantments.tooltip: Poison Guard: This item carries a potent venom that may be contracted by enemies that hit you, dealing 1d6 Strength damage. A successful Fortitude Save (DC 20) will negate this effect.
Constitution +4: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +4 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.

Proof Against Poison +3: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +3 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 4 + their Fortitude save).
